name: Jangolode Mine
summary: Jangolode Mine is a rich mineral excavation located in the rolling hills of Westfall. Once a vital source of ore and raw materials for Stormwind City, the mine has been seized by the bandits of the Defias Brotherhood.

sections.title: A Plundered Resource
sections.body: Before Westfall fell into decline, the Jangolode Mine provided a steady flow of metals crucial to the reconstruction and supply of Stormwind City. As civil order deteriorated and the kingdom withdrew its garrisons, the Defias Brotherhood seized control of the site to feed their own operations. The bandits now work the rich veins for themselves, fiercely defending their subterranean prize.

faq.answer: It is an excavation site in Westfall that historically supplied Stormwind City with essential minerals and metal ore. With regional defense weakened, it fell into hostile hands.

faq.q: Who controls the mine right now?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood holds the underground shafts, having driven out the original miners to feed their own operations.

faq.q: Why does Stormwind not reclaim the mine?
faq.answer: Stormwind is mired in political unrest and struggling to protect even its core borders. The kingdom lacks the troops to garrison Westfall's outlying mines, leaving the People's Militia and local adventurers to manage the threat.

angles.text: The Jangolode Mine remains rich in basic copper and tin deposits, making it a lucrative stop for prospectors willing to fight past the subterranean pests.
Reclaiming Westfall's resources is vital for stabilizing the kingdom, and driving the bandits out of Jangolode is one step toward restoring the region's prosperity.
